title: I Want To Know Who Your Manager Is
description: A surreal painting depicts an angry red-skinned man with an open mouth standing in a swirling vortex of colorful letters and numbers, pointing upward while wearing a shirt that reads 'I WANT TO KNOW WHO YOUR MANAGER IS'. To the right, two bored employees sit at a counter labeled 'THIS JOINT', one looking at a smartphone while the other sleeps with 'ZZZ' above their head.
